name: Escalayer
source:
A heroine of justice who came from another world in pursuit of a stolen special mineral.

Using the energy generated by excitement, she fights for peace day and night. She is the transformed form of a girl named Koenji Sayuka, and in her original world, she protected the Earth from the evil organization Dai-Lust.
She currently belongs to an organization called Die-Beat, and is known as a Legendary Warrior due to her abilities.

A heroine who appears in Alice Soft's "Beat Angel Escalayer," "Beat Angel Escalayer R,"
"Beat Wars Escalation Heroines," etc.
